subject: Information Theory
title: Cross-Entropy
description: A fast breakdown of Cross-Entropy for builders.

hook.text: Design a code based on guessed letter frequencies. If you guess wrong, messages bloat. That bloat is measurable.

buildup.text: Cross-entropy H(P,Q) is the average bits needed when the true distribution is P but you code for Q.

discovery.text: Cross-entropy = entropy + KL divergence. The unavoidable part plus the waste from being wrong.

twist.text: Minimizing cross-entropy is how neural networks train. It pushes predictions toward the true distribution.

climax.text: When cross-entropy equals entropy, your model perfectly matches reality. That's the theoretical floor.

punchline.text: Perfect model? Cross-entropy equals true entropy.

quiz.question: What happens when cross-entropy equals entropy?
options: The model's predictions perfectly match the true distribution
